title: 租户搬走
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium wide shot in a contemporary office corridor. Two East Asian employees carry cardboard boxes of desk belongings out of a leased office while a property manager watches and receives a key from the last tenant. Through the open door, rows of empty desks are visible. Tenant departure, boxes, key handover and vacant space are all legible.
